Home.heroLead: Explore a strange open world with your friends in House House's cooperative walker-talker adventure. Solve puzzles, discover useful tools, stay in contact and find your way together.
Home.startCard1Desc: Learn the essential mechanics, controls, communication systems and what to know before starting your first Big Walk.
Home.startCard2Desc: Find solutions and hints for the puzzles, towers and cooperative challenges you encounter across the world.
Home.startCard3Desc: Learn how navigation works, find important locations and understand the tools that help your group explore.
Home.startCard4Desc: Learn how hosting, Join Codes, player counts, crossplay and multiplayer sessions work.
Home.aboutP1: Big Walk is a cooperative multiplayer adventure from House House, the creators of Untitled Goose Game. Groups of friends explore a wide-open world filled with puzzles, challenges and discoveries.
Home.aboutP2: Communication is a core game mechanic. Proximity voice and text chat, gestures, walkie-talkies, megaphones and other unusual tools help players stay connected and solve problems together.
Home.codesNote: No official Big Walk redemption codes have been published. We only list verified codes here — this section stays empty until real ones appear.
Home.finalTitle: Ready to Start Your Big Walk?
Home.finalDesc: From your first session to tricky puzzles and hidden discoveries, explore our Big Walk guides and find the answers your group needs.
